import json, random, subprocess, importlib.util, importlib.machinery
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/run'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
rng = random.Random(7)
fib=[]
for i in range(512):
    a = (i << 117) | rng.getrandbits(117)
    fib.append({'prefix': sub.fmt_prefix(a,128), 'hop': i % 65536})
req = json.dumps({"op":"compile","fib":fib,"capacities":[1000000000]*8,"max_stride":16})
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(req+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
img = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('compile', img['status'], img['cuts'], img['used_bits'])
lk = json.dumps({"op":"lookup","image":img,"addresses":[sub.fmt_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(100)]})
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(lk+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('lookup resp head:', p.stdout[:120])
print('stderr:', p.stderr.decode()[-2000:])
EOF
